scripts.dev: node scripts/check-dev-ports.mjs && concurrently -n web,worker -c cyan,magenta "corepack pnpm dev:web" "corepack pnpm dev:worker"
scripts.dev:worklog: concurrently -n worklog-web,worklog-server -c cyan,magenta "corepack pnpm dev:worklog:web" "corepack pnpm dev:worklog:server"
scripts.build:worklog: corepack pnpm --filter @tong/worklog-web build && corepack pnpm --filter @tong/worklog-server build
scripts.deploy: corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm --filter @tong/worker deploy
